By giving your consent to use our website cookies, you further offer your consent to the significant and detailed use of cookies. However, you reserved the right to disable the cookies anytime you want and continue to use our website. Brixen Consultants in no manner uses the cookies to obtain any information about the user and their devices.

Cookies are known to be small electronic files in the form of texts and are used by the majority of websites to recognize and remember the users to track their activities on the given website. The cookies are also known to contain trivial information about the user and the same is downloaded to the individual’s device with the help of a web server whenever the person visits the website. The cookies further remain within the device that the user was using till the time they are either expired or deleted completely. The fundamental use of these cookies is to save a substantial amount of time for the user by letting a certain web server know that a user has returned to a certain page.
**The following purposes are the fundamental reasons for which cookies are used by browsers –**
Remember the names and passwords of users to ensure that an individual can easily log into their respective accounts.
Retrieving the given address of a person for deliveries along with invoices.
Remembering the details of a person’s credit or debit cards to make transactions easier.
Keeping the users logged into their accounts or website in case a similar web page is reopened.
Keeping track of the purchases that might be pending within the virtual shopping cart of a user.
Analyzing the purchase behavior of every user and patterns.
Enhancing the aspects of service and communication.
Displaying advertising that is in no way misleading and appropriate for users.
The development and marketing of products and services in the most appropriate manner.
Measuring the efficiency of advertisements and web searches
Optimizing various websites and making them significantly easier to navigate for a user.

The cookies that we use are referred to as ‘performance cookies’ and they intend to collect information anonymously regarding the behavior of users who might visit our website. The kinds of information we collect include the most visited web pages, the time that a user may spend on a particular page, the number of users who use different links to and from different websites or pages, and the number of sales that each page generates.

It’s imperative to note these given cookies do not collect any personal information about any individual whatsoever and they, in no way, spy on users who visit our websites. Their primary purpose is to monitor the performance of a website and based on the results improve its performance if required.
**The cookies used by Brixen Consultants are as follows –**
**_utma –** This specific cookie is used to track the number of times a person visits the website of Brixen Consultants
**_utmb –** The purpose of this cookie is to monitor and track the activities you make on the company website
**_utmc –** It is a Google Analytics cookie that is used to evaluate the backwards compatibility of a website
**_utmd –** It is also another Google Analytics cookie that tracks the path taken by a user to arrive at our company website. Those that are supplied by name or chatbox
**Hbild –** A cookie to identify the visitors to remember all the individuals who visit our website in-between visits.
**Wcsid –** The identifier of sessions that is only used to keep a relevant track of every chat session.
**Olfsk –** A cookie to identify storage that we ensure to maintain all the states of different chats across all pages. An example of that is message history.
**_okbk –** The additional information regarding chat boxes such as when they are opened or closed.
**_ok**– Most recent ID of Olark site which is concerned with security measures.
**_oklvthe –** The loader version for olark is used to improve caching.
**_okla-sed –** These are also used for caches and these are loaded from CDN and the company infrastructure.
**_okgid –** The group ID that locks a visitor.
**_okac –** These are used for caching by developing a hash regarding assets to determine whether they have changed or are required to be refreshed.

**_okck –** The usage of these is related to assessing if the browser of a visitor allows the cookies to be contained or not. Moreover, they also help to determine if the browser delete, disables, or modifies the cookies. It’s important to note that you can remove, disable or also modify the cookies in the browser that you are currently using. Each browser will provide you with relevant instructions by explaining how one may do the same. To obtain a clearer explanation further and acquire effective information, kindly visit https://www.aboutcookies.org.
